name: CYBERPUNK LEAD
tagline: Neon supersaws, PWM, glitch FM, reese and bit-crushed FX: 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: Neon leads, pluck, reese, FM and glitch
gumroad_title: CYBERPUNK LEAD - Lead Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Synthwave, Trap, Drill
summary: A lead synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (neon supersaw, chrome PWM, glitch FM, reese bass, laser pluck, neon brass, data crush and hollow glass) and 70 factory presets.
about: CYBERPUNK LEAD, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH, TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter with its own envelope, an amplitude envelope, an LFO and a master effects chain: distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.

The 70 factory presets are organized in seven banks of ten. 32 load in Mono mode for clean single-note leads and basses; the other 38 load in Poly mode, which plays up to 16 voices for chords, pads and arps.
Built for Synthwave and Retrowave, Trap and Drill leads, Hip-Hop hooks, Afrotrap melodies, G-Funk portamento leads and dark electronic bass lines.

features.d: Neon saw, chrome PWM, glitch FM, reese bass, laser pluck, neon brass, data crush and hollow glass.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from neon leads to bit-crushed FX.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated ADSR.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 48 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: CYBERPUNK LEAD plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .cppreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
